title: Vatican City
summary: Vatican City is a small enclave state within Rome and the seat of the Roman Catholic Church. The Lateran Treaty of 11 February 1929 defined its independent sovereignty, enabling the pope to exercise universal authority. It holds St Peter's Basilica, the Sistine Chapel and major Renaissance and Baroque art, and became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1984.
